purpose: Add a protected exact-main REG.RU preflight for the independent TAI service that inventories production readiness and emits redacted evidence without changing containers, Compose files, PostgreSQL, model services, secrets or network topology.
requiredBehavior: accept only an exact current main SHA and the owner confirmation phrase
verify the canonical TAI image tag digest revision label and rootless identity before SSH
pin the REG.RU production SSH host key to the protected fingerprint
discover production Compose authority from running container labels without exposing protected paths
inventory service topology host resources current revisions environment variable names PostgreSQL TAI relations active knowledge and model admission
verify existing API to private local model health without printing model endpoint or credentials
snapshot containers and protected Compose file hashes before and after inspection
emit only redacted machine-readable evidence and explicit blockers
fail closed when a required deployment prerequisite is absent
run a pull-request contract gate without using production secrets
forbiddenCapabilities: docker compose up down restart pull create or rm on the production host
container start stop restart kill remove or update
production file write edit copy install chmod chown or deletion
PostgreSQL DDL DML migration grant revoke or role mutation
systemctl start stop restart enable disable or daemon reload
secret generation rotation disclosure or persistence
production deployment or live acceptance claim
autonomous platform financial veterinary agronomic or repair action
new paid service or recurring expense
Netlify Vercel or cloud LLM dependency
